statement: At Linux v7.4-rc2 the Switch 2 Pro input device declares ABS_X, ABS_Y, ABS_RX and ABS_RY with signed 16-bit range, ABS_HAT0X/Y with range -1..1, conventional controller buttons and independent BTN_GRIPR, BTN_GRIPL and BTN_C; capture is KEY_RECORD. EV_FF FF_RUMBLE is conditional on CONFIG_NINTENDO_FF and player LEDs are configured. These are source-declared capabilities, not observed evdev events.
